Home.title: Maël Rios - Graphics and VR Developer
Home.description: I am a software engineer specialized in graphics, VR and interactive applications. I love creating meaningful and fun experiences, weaving powerful modern technologies with research and innovation. I am currently working at Barco as an R&D VR developer.

projects.title: CNN VISUALIZER
projects.description: An interactive and connected web application to visualize the inner workings of Convolutional Neural Networks.

projects.title: GLASS OVERFLOW
projects.description: A real-time Optimized SPH water simulation game with custom physics and rendering engines, coded in C++ and OpenGL, based on dynamic fluid research papers.

projects.title: TWITCH AUTOCLICKER
projects.description: A web autoclicker game for Twitch, with it's chat bot, connected to a Twitch chat that can earn points and collaborate to unlock new minigames and power ups!

projects.title: 3D AI ROBOT SIMULATOR
projects.description: I was in charge of developing a brand new 3D simulator in Unity for AlphAI, Learning Robot's AI learning robot solution.

projects.title: ECOLIFE
projects.description: A 3D Unity game where you play as a fox, exploring a world transforming by human hands in real-time.

projects.title: SLUG SPROOCH
projects.description: Ludum Dare 56 entry. Slug Sprooch 2D game where you launch slugs to the other side of the road, and hope they don't get squashed by the cars!

projects.title: THOUGHT PATROL
projects.description: Global Game Jam 2025 entry. Thought Patrol is a Unity 3D game where you play as a Thought officer, charged of censoring public speech following the orders of the King. Will you be able to handle the never ending rule changes?

projects.title: KISS MARRY KILL
projects.description: Ludum Dare 55 entry. KMK is a fun dating simulator where you try to manage and get a date with one of hell' inhabitants, while trying to avoid getting summoned by petty humans. Choose how to resolve the weird requests, at the risk of angering a possible date!

projects.title: OPENGL PROJECTS
projects.description: A collection of small OpenGL projects, including shadowmapping, rigidbody physics, SPH simulation, 3D model subdivision algorithm, etc...

projects.title: ROOMS XYZ STEAMROOM
projects.description: Rooms XYZ is a very fun 3D pixel ortographic web game engine! I had fun creating this room in it, which is a minimal steam room to test the engine's coding and API capabilities.
